fields.name: Armor Of Saint Terragnis
fields.benefit: Hostile spells that target you are DC 18 to cast. Once per month, you can summon an Avatar of Saint Terragnis (treat as an archangel) to fight by your side for 10 rounds.

fields.name: Amulet Of Vitality
fields.benefit: Your Constitution stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing this amulet.

fields.name: Alabaster Destrier
fields.benefit: Once per day, the wielder can speak the command word to turn the statuette into a pegasus that accepts neutral or lawful riders. The statuette remains in this form for 1 hour.

fields.name: Amulet Of Secrecy
fields.benefit: You can't be detected by divination magic such as the scrying spell or a Crystal Ball while wearing this amulet.
fields.curse: You constantly have the sensation of being watched. "St. Terragnis wore this armor to fight the Legion of the Ninth Circle. She triumphed that day ; so will we. " -Iraga, half-orc priest

fields.name: Armor Of The Oni
fields.benefit: You can speak and understand Diabolic. Your melee weapon attacks deal +1 damage.
fields.curse: You have disadvantage on attacks and spellcasting checks against demons.

fields.name: Bag Of Badgers
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can reach inside the bag and pull out an angry badger. You can throw the badger up to a near distance. The badger attacks the nearest creature for 3 rounds before waddling away.

fields.name: Bag Of Devouring
fields.curse: This bag devours and destroys anything placed inside it in 1d6 rounds.

fields.name: Bead Of Force
fields.benefit: You can throw this bead at one target up to a near distance. If you hit, the target becomes caught in a resilient sphere spell (pg. 69).

fields.name: Bag Of Holding
fields.benefit: This bag has an interdimensional space inside that can hold up to 10 gear slots.
fields.curse: Placing this item inside another Bag of Holding or a Portable Hole destroys both items and all held inside them.

fields.name: Blade Of Vengeance
fields.benefit: You have advantage on attacks against undead creatures with this sword. You can use the sword to cast turn undead once per day (+4 bonus).

fields.name: Boots Of Dancing
fields.curse: As soon as you don these boots, you begin cavorting and dancing uncontrollably. You move randomly each turn and must pass a DC 15 Dexterity check to remove the boots.

fields.name: Boots Of Hovering
fields.benefit: You can walk on an insubstantial surface for 1 turn at a time. You fall through the surface if you end your turn on it.

fields.name: Boots Of The Cat
fields.benefit: You can jump up to a near distance from a standstill. Your checks to move silently are always easy (DC 9).

fields.name: Bracers Of Archery
fields.benefit: You deal +1 damage with ranged weapons.

fields.name: Bracers Of Defense
fields.benefit: You get a +1 bonus to your armor class.

fields.name: Brak'S Cube Of Perfection
fields.benefit: Roll the cube by rolling a d6. Your corresponding stat permanently increases to 18 (+4). 1. Strength. 2. Dexterity. 3. Constitution. 4. Intelligence. 5. Wisdom. 6. Charisma. After being rolled, Brak's Cube of Perfection teleports to a random location in the multiverse.

fields.name: Brak'S Book Of Misspells
fields.curse: This spellbook contains one scroll each of acid arrow (pg. 54), fireball (pg. 60), and sleep (pg. 71). When a wizard tries to cast or learn a spell from these scrolls, the spell targets the caster on a success.

fields.name: Circlet Of Wisdom
fields.benefit: Your Wisdom stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing this circlet.

fields.name: Cloak Of Elvenkind
fields.benefit: Your checks to hide are always easy (DC 9). Once per day, you can become invisible for 5 rounds. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.

fields.name: Cloak Of The Bat
fields.benefit: You can fly a near distance as your movement while in a shadowy area.
fields.curse: Each time you use the cloak to fly, roll a d20. On a result of 1, you and your gear turn into a small bat for 3 rounds.

fields.name: Crystal Ball
fields.benefit: Only wizards can use a Crystal Ball. You can use it to cast the scrying spell (pg. 70). If you fail the spellcasting check to cast scrying, the Crystal Ball ceases to function for a day.

fields.name: Dagger Of The Goblin Hero
fields.benefit: You can speak Goblin. All goblinoid creatures react to you with a friendly attitude.

fields.name: Egg Of The Cockatrice
fields.benefit: Once per week, you can speak a command word that causes a cockatrice to hatch and follow your commands for 5 rounds before flying away. The egg repairs itself over one week.

fields.name: Flying Carpet
fields.benefit: The carpet fits two riders (one is the driver). It can fly double near on the driver's turn.

fields.name: Genie Lamp
fields.benefit: Rubbing the lamp causes its resident djinni (50% chance) or efreeti (50% chance) to emerge. A djinni grants its summoner one wish spell (pg. 73) before disappearing. An efreeti does the same, but only after being defeated in combat.

fields.name: Gloves Of Agility
fields.benefit: Your Dexterity stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing these gloves.

fields.name: Goblin Bomb
fields.benefit: You can light the bomb's fuse and throw it a near distance. It explodes in 1d4 rounds, dealing 2d8 damage to everything in near range.

fields.name: Gauntlets Of Might
fields.benefit: Your Strength stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing these gauntlets.

fields.name: Greataxe Of The Horde
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can turn a regular hit with this weapon into a critical hit.
fields.curse: Each time you go below half your hit points, make a DC 12 Charisma check. On a failure, you enter a battle rage for 1d4 rounds and must attack the nearest creature.

fields.name: Hat Of Intellect
fields.benefit: Your Intelligence stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing this hat.

fields.name: Hat Of The Hound
fields.benefit: You can transform into a mastiff each day for up to 10 rounds total. Your clothing and possessions transform with you.

fields.name: Helm Of Mind Reading
fields.benefit: You can cast the detect thoughts spell (pg. 58) three times per day (+4 bonus).

fields.name: Horned Helm Of Ramlaat
fields.benefit: This helm grants you a +1 bonus to your armor class. You have advantage on any check you make to knock down creatures or objects.
fields.curse: You feel compelled to headbutt delicate objects.

fields.name: Hourglass Of The Black Sands
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can turn the hourglass when you cast a spell. The spell's effects last 1d4 rounds longer.

fields.name: Immovable Rod
fields.benefit: When you click the button, the rod becomes fixed in space (holds 5,000 lbs). Clicking the button again ends the effect.

fields.name: Jewel Of Barbalt
fields.benefit: You roll a critical success on an 18-20.
fields.curse: You roll a critical failure on a 1-3.

fields.name: Kytherian Cog
fields.benefit: You start every session with a luck token.

fields.name: Longbow Of The Elven Kings
fields.benefit: You have advantage on attacks with this bow against unnatural creatures and outsiders.

fields.name: Memnon'S Discordant Blade
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can utterly annihilate one creature of level 9 or less that you damage with this blade. The creature can pass a DC 18 Constitution check to take 3d8 damage instead.
fields.curse: You cannot relinquish ownership of this blade unless it is taken from you by a creature that defeats you in combat. For each day you do not slay a LV 2 or greater creature with this sword, you lose 1d6 hit points. These are restored only when you kill a LV 2 or greater creature with the sword.

fields.name: Memnon'S Blazing Javelin
fields.benefit: The javelin always returns to your hand after being thrown. Once per day, when you throw this javelin, you can turn it into lightning as per the lightning bolt spell (no spellcasting check).

fields.name: Magic Ink
fields.benefit: The ink's writing is invisible when cool and can only be seen when warmed up by a nearby source of strong heat. There's enough for 1d4 uses.

fields.name: Memnon'S Entropic Armor
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can speak the armor's command word. Until your next turn, all non-magical weapons that strike you are instantly unmade, shattering into dust. You take no damage from them.

fields.name: Mirror Of Mischief
fields.curse: The first time a humanoid creature looks into this mirror, the mirror creates an evil and malicious duplicate of them. The duplicate can step from the mirror and is an exact copy of the subject (except for magical gear, which looks identical but is mundane in nature). The evil duplicate can live indefinitely outside the mirror. It attempts to sow chaos in the life of the creature it duplicated.

fields.name: Moonwrought Chainmail
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can speak the armor's command word. You gain a +1 bonus to your next spellcasting check or ranged attack.

fields.name: Necklace Of Charm
fields.benefit: Your Charisma stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing this necklace.

fields.name: Necrotic Mace Of Withering
fields.benefit: While holding the mace, you can turn cure wounds spells you cast into harmful magic that instead inflicts the same amount of damage it would heal.
fields.curse: If you use the mace to cast an inverted cure wounds spell, you are haunted by nightmares that night. You must pass a DC 12 Wisdom check during your next rest or gain no benefit from resting.

fields.name: Obsidian Witchknife
fields.benefit: When you cast a spell while holding this dagger, you may wound yourself with it. Add the amount of damage you take to your spellcasting check.

fields.name: Onyx Destrier
fields.benefit: Once per day, the wielder can speak the command word to turn the statuette into a nightmare that accepts neutral or chaotic riders. The statuette remains in this form for 1 hour.

fields.name: Nightcloak Armor
fields.benefit: Once per day, you may choose to automatically pass a Dexterity check to hide.

fields.name: Ophidian Armor
fields.benefit: You have advantage on checks to avoid the effects of poison.

fields.name: Pearl Of Power
fields.benefit: Once per day, you may regain the ability to cast a spell you have lost. This cannot restore a spell lost due to a critical spellcasting failure.

fields.name: Pipe Of The Rolling Hills
fields.benefit: Up to three times per day, regain 1d4 hit points when you smoke this pipe.

fields.name: Pipes Of The Sewers
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can play these pipes to summon 2d6 giant rats. The rats obey you for d6 rounds, and then they scatter and flee.
fields.curse: If you stop playing while the rats are present, they turn on you and attack.

fields.name: Portable Hole
fields.benefit: The Portable Hole folds open on a flat surface into a 6-foot wide, 6-foot deep hole. It has 20 gear slots of storage. The hole closes when you fold the cloth into a small square.
fields.curse: Placing this item inside a Bag of Holding or another Portable Hole destroys both items and all held inside them. "There's nothing better than a cheese, a pipe, and a story. " -Ralina, halfling thief, relating a halfling saying

fields.name: Potion Of Extirpation
fields.benefit: You can pour the potion on one object or creature filling up to a close area. The target is utterly removed from reality and cannot be returned by anything short of a wish spell.

fields.name: Potion Of Flying
fields.benefit: You can fly a near distance for 10 rounds when you drink this potion.

fields.name: Potion Of Forgetfulness
fields.benefit: If you serve this potion to an intelligent being and that being drinks it, the imbiber permanently forgets one memory of your choosing.

fields.name: Potion Of Giant Strength
fields.benefit: Your Strength becomes 18 (+4) and you deal x2 damage on melee attacks for 10 rounds.

fields.name: Potion Of Healing
fields.benefit: The imbiber of this potion regains hit points based on their level. LV 0-3: 1d6 hit points. LV 4-6: 2d8 hit points. LV 7-9: 3d10 hit points. LV 10+: 4d12 hit points.

fields.name: Potion Of Invisibility
fields.benefit: When you drink this potion, you become invisible for 10 rounds or until you attack or cast a spell.

fields.name: Potion Of Legendary Deeds
fields.benefit: When you drink this potion, you gain one level and your XP total resets to zero.

fields.name: Potion Of Polymorph
fields.benefit: When you drink this potion, it casts the polymorph spell (pg. 67) on you with a duration of 1 hour instead of 10 rounds.

fields.name: Potion Of Vitality
fields.benefit: When you drink this potion, roll your class's hit points die. You permanently gain that many HP.
fields.curse: If you drink more than one Potion of Vitality in your lifetime, you must pass a DC 18 Constitution check each time or die instantly.

fields.name: Ring Of Feather Falling
fields.benefit: Once per day, the ring can cast feather fall (pg. 60) on you when you fall.

fields.name: Ring Of Fireballs
fields.benefit: You can pluck the glass marble from the ring and throw it up to a far distance, causing a fireball spell (pg. 60) to bloom at the site of impact. The glass marble regrows after you successfully complete a rest.

fields.name: Ring Of Invisibility
fields.benefit: Once per day, the ring can cast the invisibility spell (pg. 63) on you.
fields.curse: There is a cumulative 1% chance each time you rest that your sleep is ruined by apocalyptic nightmares, and you gain no benefit from resting. This resets to a 1% chance each time it triggers.

fields.name: Ring Of Ramlaat
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can enter a rage where you deal double damage for 5 rounds. During the rage, you can't cast spells and enemies have advantage on melee attacks against you.

fields.name: Robe Of The Druid
fields.benefit: Only a wizard with the Druid title can wear this robe. Your unarmored AC becomes 15 plus your Dexterity modifier. Twice per day, you can regain the ability to cast one lost spell. You have advantage on casting the shapechange spell. When you cast it, its duration is 1 hour instead of focus.

fields.name: Robe Of The Sorcerer
fields.benefit: Only a wizard with the Sorcerer title can wear this robe. Your unarmored AC becomes 15 plus your Dexterity modifier. When you cast a spell that deals damage, add your Intelligence modifier to the total. You have advantage on casting the power word kill spell.

fields.name: Robe Of The Archmage
fields.benefit: Only a wizard with the Archmage title can wear this robe. Your unarmored AC becomes 15 plus your Dexterity modifier. Choose three spells you know. Their spellcasting DC is always 11. You have advantage on casting the disintegrate spell.

fields.name: Scarab Of Protection
fields.benefit: If you die, make a DC 18 Constitution check. If you succeed, you are unconscious instead of dead.

fields.name: Scimitar Of The Ash Moon
fields.benefit: If you roll a critical hit with this weapon, the target is beheaded. It dies instantly if decapitation would kill it.

fields.name: Shield Of The Crusader
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can speak a prayer to wreathe the shield in holy flames, granting +2 to your AC for 3 rounds.

fields.name: Shield Of The Lion
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can command the lion to animate and bellow a ferocious roar. All hostile creatures within near range must immediately make a morale check.

fields.name: Shield Of The Witch-King
fields.benefit: You take half damage from undead creatures.
fields.curse: If you go to 0 HP, the spirit of Ix-Natheer tries to steal your body. He blocks healing magic from affecting you. If you die, Ix-Natheer possesses you.

fields.name: Shortsword Of The Thief
fields.benefit: Once per day, regain a luck token you just spent.

fields.name: Silver Mace Of Wrath
fields.benefit: This weapon deals double damage against creatures with lycanthropy.

fields.name: Sphere Of Annihilation
fields.benefit: This sphere utterly destroys all matter it touches. Intelligent beings can move the flying sphere a near distance by passing a DC 18 Intelligence check. If multiple creatures vie for control of the sphere, it is a contested Intelligence check instead. Wizards have advantage on this check. The winner moves the sphere a near distance. If the sphere moves into a space occupied by a creature, the being controlling the sphere makes an attack roll against that creature with a +7 bonus. On a hit, the creature is obliterated.

fields.name: Spyglass Of True Sight
fields.benefit: When you look through the spyglass, you can see invisible creatures and objects.
fields.curse: The wielder feels a compulsion to look at everything through the spyglass.

fields.name: Staff Of Healing
fields.benefit: Once per day, you can touch a creature with the staff to heal it for 1d6 hit points.

fields.name: Staff Of Ord
fields.benefit: Functions as a wand of dimension door (pg. 59), fireball (pg. 60), sending (pg. 70), and telekinesis (pg. 72). Unlike a wand, the staff remains intact if you roll a 1 on your spellcasting checks. Hostile spells targeting you are DC 18 to cast.

fields.name: The Kytherian Mechanism
fields.benefit: A handle turns The Kytherian Mechanism's mighty wheels, but it doesn't function until its seven missing Kytherian Cogs are replaced. Once functional, activating the mechanism allows the operator to undo one event of their choosing from history. Then, the seven Kytherian Cogs magically scatter to far-flung locations.

fields.name: The Malediction Infernal
fields.benefit: A chaotic being who reads this tome gains a level and learns the Diabolic language. A non-chaotic being who reads this book must pass a DC 18 Wisdom check or lose one level. After being read, the tome teleports to a far-flung location.

fields.name: Staff Of The Cobra
fields.benefit: All snakes regard you with a friendly attitude unless you do something to upset them. Once per day, you can throw the staff to the ground. It becomes a giant snake for 5 rounds that obeys your mental commands. If the giant snake goes to 0 HP, it reverts into a staff.
fields.curse: You have disadvantage on attacks and casting hostile spells targeting snakes.

fields.name: Sword Of The Ancients
fields.benefit: The sword is unbreakable and can carve through any material. The owner can summon the sword to their hand if it's on the same plane.

fields.name: Thrice-Blessed Sword
fields.benefit: You deal double damage against demons, devils, and undead.

fields.name: Tome Mordanticus
fields.benefit: When you read the tome, you learn three True Names (pg. 319) of three beings you choose. Your True Name also appears in the book after reading it.

fields.name: Tome Of Gehemna
fields.benefit: Each day, a random wizard spell scroll appears inside the tome, replacing the spell scroll from the prior day.

fields.name: Tome Of Hadebe
fields.benefit: The tome contains one each of the following scrolls: burning hands (pg. 56), fireball (pg. 60), and prismatic orb (pg. 67).

fields.name: Trident Of The Seas
fields.benefit: You can breathe underwater, as well as speak to and understand wild sea creatures. Once per day, you can cast control water (pg. 57) with a +4 bonus.

fields.name: True Name
fields.benefit: You have advantage on attack rolls and spellcasting checks targeting a creature whose True Name you utter.

fields.name: Wand Of Unlife
fields.benefit: This wand contains the spells animate dead (pg. 54) and create undead (pg. 58).
fields.curse: Each time you use the wand to cast a spell, you take 1d4 points of Constitution damage. If you reach 0 Constitution from this effect, you die and turn into a zombie.

fields.name: Wand Of Warding
fields.benefit: This wand contains the spells dispel magic (pg. 59) and protection from energy (pg. 68).
fields.curse: Each time you fail a spellcasting check with this wand, you also lose the ability to cast a random spell you know until you complete a rest.

fields.name: Warhammer Of The Dwarf Lords
fields.benefit: This weapon has the thrown property (pg. 37) to a near distance. It always returns to your hand after being thrown. Your attacks with this weapon deal double damage against giants.

fields.name: War Horn Of The Angels
fields.benefit: Only a lawful being can wield the horn. Once per day, you can blow the horn to cast rebuke unholy (pg. 69) with a +4 bonus. A demon or devil who hears the horn has disadvantage on its Charisma check vs. your rebuke unholy spellcasting check.

fields.name: Well Of Many Worlds
fields.benefit: The Well of Many Worlds folds open on a flat surface into a 6-foot wide hole. Creatures can jump into the hole once per day each to be transported to a random plane of existence.

fields.name: Wraith Chain
fields.benefit: Once per day, you may cause an attack that hits you to miss instead. 323Join The Dark

fields.name: Shadowdark Rpg Community
fields.desc: Find other Shadowdark RPG players, Game Masters, and creators in The Arcane Library's Discord server! It's a friendly place to organize games, share ideas, and ask questions. Discord link: https://discord.gg/ thearcanelibrary Also, keep an eye out at gaming conventions for Shadowdark events and open tables! Kelsey Dionne, Shadowdark RPG's creator and head of The Arcane Library, runs open-table, unscheduled games at Gary Con each year. Come find where she's lurking and jump in! You can also stay up-to-date on Shadowdark RPG happenings by joining the newsletter. Newsletter link: https://www. thearcanelibrary.com/pages/ shadowdark-rpg-newsletterFIND ADVENTURES

fields.name: And Content
fields.desc: Visit thearcanelibrary.com for the latest in Shadowdark RPG adventures and articles. There, you can grab print or PDF issues of Cursed Scroll, the official Shadowdark zine bursting with themed character options, monsters, locations, and critically-acclaimed adventures. Follow The Arcane Library on youtube.com/thearcanelibrary for video guides, tips, tricks, and adventure walkthroughs! Finally, spectacular creators such as Taylor Seely-Wright, Laurin-David Weggen, James Mishler, Jake Savala, and Sersa Victory have published an amazing array of adventures, settings, character options and more under the Shadowdark RPG Third-Party License. Check out their excellent work on drivethrurpg.com and itch.io! 324DEDICATION To my amazing wife, Jessee, for encouraging me in all my work. To The Arcane Library Discord arcanists for playtesting and shaping Shadowdark RPG. To the stalwart Circle: Doc, Scott, Brian, Jake, Jesse, Matt, Paul, Dason. To the wise Council: Alex, X, Joe, B. To Lauren for being my best friend, coven-sister, and fellow adventurer. To my shield-brother, Brandon, for bringing about a new RPG design era, sharing joy from the heart, and helping me believe in myself. To James Mishler and the Merlin's Keep crew for being lifelong friends, mentors, and family. To the Fairhill Four for reminding me why I love gaming: BJ, Hessick, Bennett, and Teri. To Castle Sauvage for sharing their immense insight. To all the hammers that were destroyed along the way.FONTS JSL Blackletter font © 2023 Jeffrey S. Lee.
